QUIC packet metadata treap initialization, insertion, removal, minimum lookup, and clear functions.

# Purpose
This file implements helper functions for `fd_quic_pkt_meta` data management in the QUIC packet metadata layer. It initializes and clears packet metadata trackers and data sets, seeds the metadata pool, and provides basic operations to insert, remove, and query packet metadata entries. The code works with four encryption levels in [`fd_quic_pkt_meta_tracker_init`](<#fd_quic_pkt_meta_tracker_init>), where it creates a treap-backed set for each `sent_pkt_metas` entry and stores the shared pool pointer in the tracker.

The main data operations are [`fd_quic_pkt_meta_insert`](<#fd_quic_pkt_meta_insert>), [`fd_quic_pkt_meta_remove`](<#fd_quic_pkt_meta_remove>), [`fd_quic_pkt_meta_remove_range`](<#fd_quic_pkt_meta_remove_range>), and [`fd_quic_pkt_meta_min`](<#fd_quic_pkt_meta_min>). These functions use treap and pool helpers to manage metadata elements by packet number, remove entries in a packet number range, release removed elements back to the pool, and return the smallest entry in a set. The file does not define a public protocol interface by itself, but it does provide the core internal operations used to maintain QUIC packet metadata state.
